system.description: This Skill is used to design and build things with moving parts, fluids, or chemicals wholly out of Misc. Junk with no inherent bonuses, though they may have situational bonuses. Examples include a watch, a water pump, or bullets. Starting on the Fourth Floor, you may make use of an Engineering Table to make your mundane items easier to craft. Make an Unopposed Skill Check. On Success, you create the item.

upgrades.description: Choose a mundane item type to specialize in. You have Advantage when creating an item of that type.
You may craft your specialty item with a +1 bonus level enchantment.
You may craft your specialty item with up to +2 bonus level enchantment, and it takes half the time.

system.limitations: Cannot create vehicles or high-powered engines (see Gear Head for that p. 192).
